COP.headline: 9 Of 11 Sectors Fall As Growth Leads
COP.summary: Monday’s regular session has nine sectors lower and two higher, with growth sectors occupying the top two positions. The leaders are separated rather than clustered, with no single gap clearly standing apart from the other breaks across the table.

COP.headline: 9 Of 11 Sectors Rise In Friday Trading As Cyclicals Lead
COP.summary: Nine of 11 sectors are higher in Friday’s regular session, with cyclical sectors holding the top three positions. The leaders are separated rather than clustered, with no single gap clearly standing apart from the other breaks across the table.

COP.headline: Morgan Stanley Maintains Overweight on ConocoPhillips, Raises Price Target to $159
8 Of 11 Sectors Fall Wednesday As Defensives Lead
COP.summary: Three sectors are higher and eight are lower in Wednesday's regular session, with defensive sectors holding the top three positions. The leaders are separated rather than clustered, with no single sector pulling away from the group.

COP.headline: Cyclicals Lead Sectors In Tuesday Trading As Health Care Trails
COP.summary: Four sectors are higher and seven are lower in Tuesday’s regular session, with cyclical sectors holding two of the top three positions. Materials sits well clear of the lower group, separated by a margin several times wider than any other gap in the table.

COP.headline: 9 Of 11 Sectors Rise Monday As Cyclicals Lead
COP.summary: Nine of 11 sectors are higher in Monday’s regular session, with cyclical sectors holding two of the top three positions. The leaders are separated rather than clustered, with Energy, Communication Services and Financials setting a varied pace across the top of the table.
